description: This file defines logging classes for the vtiger CRM system, including LoggerManager for obtaining Logger instances, the Logger class for managing log levels and emitting logs, and LoggerAppenderFile for log file output.

classes.name: LoggerManager
classes.description: Provides static method to retrieve Logger instances based on a given name.

classes.name: Logger
classes.description: Main logging class managing different log levels and output methods.

classes.name: LoggerAppenderFile
classes.description: Handles writing log messages to a file with permission management.

methods.name: LoggerManager.getlogger
methods.description: Static method returning a Logger instance configured with the specified name.

methods.name: Logger.__construct
methods.description: Initializes a Logger with a specific name and configuration info; enables debug level for migration.

methods.name: Logger.emit
methods.description: Emits a log message at a specified level, writing to the designated log file.

methods.name: Logger.info
methods.description: Logs an informational message if INFO level is enabled.

methods.name: Logger.debug
methods.description: Logs a debug message if DEBUG level is enabled.

methods.name: Logger.warn
methods.description: Logs a warning message if WARN level is enabled.

methods.name: Logger.fatal
methods.description: Logs a fatal error message if FATAL level is enabled.

methods.name: Logger.error
methods.description: Logs an error message if ERROR level is enabled.

methods.name: Logger.isLevelEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific log level is enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: Logger.isDebugEnabled
methods.description: Checks if debug logging is enabled.

methods.name: LoggerAppenderFile.emit
methods.description: Writes the log message to the designated file, updating permissions if needed.
